security._note: Every key below is read by code. Keys describing capabilities that do not exist have been removed rather than left asserting them: auth.type said 'oidc_sso' with no OIDC anywhere, and opa.url and vault.url named services nothing contacted.

_not_implemented: OIDC single sign-on: no code. The mechanism is a shared key.
Open Policy Agent: no per-role or per-dataset authorization exists. A valid key grants every endpoint.

security._secrets_note: Keys here are plaintext. Prefer MEG_API_KEYS in the environment. There is no Vault integration; the previous vault.url implied managed secrets while this list sat in the same file.

phi._note: backend 'patterns' matches direct identifiers only (national id, email, phone, date of birth, long digit runs). It does not detect names or addresses. backend 'presidio' needs the phi extra and raises at startup if it is missing rather than silently scanning nothing -- which is what the previous presidio.enabled=true did, with no Presidio code anywhere in the repository.

observability._note: Every key below is read by code.

prometheus._note: Served by the API itself; scrape it directly.

mlflow._note: Optional. Needs the `tracking` extra; enabling it without mlflow installed raises at startup rather than recording nothing. Risk models already persist with their held-out metrics, and training runs appear in the audit log.

audit._note: Append-only JSONL. Metadata only, never patient content.

_not_implemented: Langfuse: it traces LLM and RAG generation, and this system has no generation. Retrieval returns cited records and stops.
